applicabilityBasis.summary: bnbUSD is a decentralized crypto-collateralized CDP stablecoin minted on BNB Smart Chain against WBNB and Lista slisBNB (SY-clisBNB) through Sigma Money smart contracts. Bitdrome Foundation is disclosed only as the front-end interface provider and expressly disclaims operating the protocol or undertaking any obligation to redeem bnbUSD for a fixed amount of national currency or bank-deposit monetary value, placing it outside the GENIUS Act section 2(22) payment-stablecoin issuer regime.

references.label: GENIUS Act Public Law 119-27: payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-27. bnbUSD is a decentralized BSC CDP token backed by WBNB and SY-clisBNB with on-chain collateral redemption and no legal issuer obligated to redeem for fiat currency. Bitdrome Foundation is named in the Terms of Service solely as the interface provider and is therefore not assigned as issuerEntity. No GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification or monthly attestation applies.
